def: The mean, median, or mode that best fits the data.
defEs: La media, mediana o moda que mejor describe los datos.
alt: Illustration of Appropriate Measures of Center: The mean, median, or mode that best fits the data.

def: Add all the numbers, then divide by how many.
defEs: Suma todos los números y divide entre cuántos hay.
alt: Illustration of Mean: Add all the numbers, then divide by how many.

def: The middle number when they are in order.
defEs: El número del medio cuando están en orden.
alt: Illustration of Median: The middle number when they are in order.

def: A number far bigger or smaller than the rest.
defEs: Un número mucho mayor o menor que los demás.
alt: Illustration of Outlier: A number far bigger or smaller than the rest.

def: Most data sits on one side, with a tail on the other.
defEs: La mayoría de los datos está de un lado, con una cola del otro.
alt: Illustration of Skewed: Most data sits on one side, with a tail on the other.

def: Where the values sit and how far apart they are.
defEs: Dónde están los valores y qué tan separados están.
alt: Illustration of Data distribution: Where the values sit and how far apart they are.

def: How far apart the numbers are.
defEs: Qué tan separados están los números.
alt: Illustration of Variability: How far apart the numbers are.

def: Values that are near each other.
defEs: Valores que están cerca unos de otros.
alt: Illustration of Cluster: Values that are near each other.

def: An empty space where there is no data.
defEs: Un espacio vacío donde no hay datos.
alt: Illustration of Gap: An empty space where there is no data.
